title: Numbers spoken from television sets

tellings.quote: from being drowned. And Keiel reports on cases where people heard numbers being spoken at them from out of television sets

plain: In the 1960s, according to the writer John Keel, who investigated strange happenings in America, people reported hearing numbers spoken at them out of their television sets. The philosopher Jason Jorjani brings this up on the show as something Keel "reports on." He sets it beside Keel's accounts of mysterious Men in Black, strangers said to visit witnesses, as a sign that whatever lies behind these events can reach people through ordinary things in their homes.
